mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses equity discount rates and corporate profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate and rising retail sales indicate strong monetary policy support for consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong consumer demand
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production signals expanding supply capacity that increases corporate utilization and profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts above 2000.0 thousand units indicate robust residential construction, supporting consumer spending and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 2000.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth exceeding 200,000 jobs per month signals a rapidly expanding labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate revenues, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and declines in the unemployment rate signal a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with tight labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth above 3.0% quarterly annualized rate indicates a late-cycle expansion phase that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0%.
